snippet.title: What Sugar Does to Your Body (3D Animation)
snippet.description:
One can of soda can hold more sugar than the World Health Organization's ideal limit for an entire day. So what actually happens inside your body when all that sugar goes down? This 3D medical animation follows sugar through your blood, liver, heart and teeth, with every number sourced.

Chapters:
0:00 One can of soda
0:31 Your blood and insulin
1:39 Your liver turns sugar into fat
2:12 Your heart and arteries
2:47 Your teeth and the WHO limit
3:27 The twist: fruit vs juice
4:11 The best news: how fast your body recovers

Sources:
• WHO sugars guideline, 2015: https://www.who.int/news/item/04-03-2015-who-calls-on-countries-to-reduce-sugars-intake-among-adults-and-children
• Malik et al., Diabetes Care 2010: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20693348/
• ICMR-INDIAB, Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol 2023: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37301218/
• Softic et al., Dig Dis Sci 2016: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26856717/
• Yang et al., JAMA Intern Med 2014: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24493081/
• Moynihan & Kelly, J Dent Res 2014: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24323509/
• Muraki et al., BMJ 2013: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23990623/
• Schwarz et al., Gastroenterology 2017: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28579536/
